WITH stable_pat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.pat_ref
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tou ON tou.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  WHERE asd.rec_status = 'Stable'
    AND lower(tou.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') IN ('moderate','significant')
), pat_missed AS (
  SELECT pat_ref, AVG(miss_appt) AS avg_missed_appointments
  FROM encounters GROUP BY pat_ref
), latest_sse AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.pat_ref) e.pat_ref,
    (CASE asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weak' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS sse
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  ORDER BY e.pat_ref, e.time_mark DESC, e.enc_key DESC
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.pat_ref AS patient_id, m.avg_missed_appointments, l.sse AS most_recent_sse
FROM stable_pat s
JOIN pat_missed m ON m.pat_ref = s.pat_ref
JOIN latest_sse l ON l.pat_ref = s.pat_ref
WHERE m.avg_missed_appointments > 2 OR l.sse < 3

WITH enc AS (
  SELECT e.clin_id, e.fac_id, e.pat_ref, e.enc_key, e.miss_appt
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate','Comprehensive','Extensive')
), crisis AS (
  SELECT enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS total_crisis
  FROM enc JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = enc.enc_key
  GROUP BY enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT clin_id, fac_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS n_pat, SUM(miss_appt) AS total_missed
  FROM enc GROUP BY clin_id, fac_id
), psm AS (
  SELECT a.clin_id, a.fac_id,
    1.0 / (1 + COALESCE(c.total_crisis,0)::numeric / NULLIF(a.n_pat,0) + COALESCE(a.total_missed,0)::numeric / NULLIF(a.n_pat,0)) AS psm
  FROM agg a LEFT JOIN crisis c ON c.clin_id = a.clin_id AND c.fac_id = a.fac_id
)
SELECT clin_id AS clinician_id, fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(psm, 2) AS psm,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fac_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS psm_rank
FROM psm
ORDER BY fac_id, psm_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH hr AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, e.ab_ref, e.enc_key, e.time_mark, e.fac_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.pat_ref ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC, e.enc_key DESC) AS rn
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  WHERE (asr.suic_risk = 'High' OR asr.phq9_scr > 15 OR asr.gad7_scr > 15)
    AND (f.env_stress = 'Severe' OR f.life_impact = 'Severe')
), tes AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref,
    AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS avg_tes
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref
)
SELECT hr.pat_ref AS patient_id, hr.ab_ref AS assessment_id, hr.time_mark AS assessment_date,
  ROUND(t.avg_tes) AS avg_tes_rounded,
  CASE WHEN f.env_stress = 'Severe' THEN f.env_stress ELSE f.life_impact END AS stress_or_impact_level
FROM hr
JOIN tes t ON t.pat_ref = hr.pat_ref
JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = hr.fac_id
WHERE hr.rn = 1 AND t.avg_tes < 2
ORDER BY hr.time_mark DESC
LIMIT 50
note: All encounters share one timestamp, so 'most recent' and the date ordering are ties; level column shows the Severe value (env_stress if Severe, else life_impact).

WITH dx AS (
  SELECT e.enc_key, e.pat_ref, asd.prim_dx
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  WHERE asd.prim_dx IS NOT NULL
), crisis AS (
  SELECT dx.prim_dx, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS total_crisis
  FROM dx JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = dx.enc_key
  GROUP BY dx.prim_dx
), pats AS (
  SELECT prim_dx, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS patient_count FROM dx GROUP BY prim_dx
)
SELECT p.prim_dx AS diagnosis, p.patient_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.total_crisis, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(p.patient_count, 0), 2) AS cif
FROM pats p LEFT JOIN crisis c ON c.prim_dx = p.prim_dx
ORDER BY cif DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH p AS (
  SELECT split_part(therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric AS intensity,
         split_part(treatment_cost_eff, ' ', 1)::numeric AS cost_eff
  FROM assessmentbasics
  WHERE pat_owner_ref = 'P425079'
)
SELECT ROUND(6000.0 / (100 * 1.25), 2) AS affordable_therapy_hours,
       (intensity >= 30) AS meets_intensity_target,
       ROUND(cost_eff * 6000, 2) AS projected_qol_gain,
       (cost_eff * 6000 > 650) AS exceeds_clinical_threshold
FROM p
note: Intensity and cost-effectiveness read from the database (0.11976..., 29.87) rather than the rounded figures in the question; with 0.1197 the gain would be 718.20.

WITH fac AS (
  SELECT f.fac_key,
    CASE f.com_res WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Extensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS resource_score,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tou.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS tar
  FROM facilities f
  JOIN encounters e ON e.fac_id = f.fac_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tou ON tou.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY f.fac_key, f.com_res
)
SELECT ROUND(CORR(resource_score, tar)::numeric, 4) AS craa
FROM fac
WHERE resource_score IS NOT NULL

WITH pfis AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
    AVG(CASE lower(asd.func_imp) WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), frai AS (
  SELECT fac_key AS fac_id,
    CASE com_res WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Extensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai
  FROM facilities
), tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
    AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), tar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tou.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tou ON tou.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), mar AS (
  SELECT fac_id, SUM(miss_appt)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref), 0) AS mar
  FROM encounters GROUP BY fac_id
), m AS (
  SELECT fr.fac_id, p.pfis - fr.frai AS rdd,
    (t.tes + ta.tar * 3) / 2 AS eas, ma.mar
  FROM frai fr
  JOIN pfis p ON p.fac_id = fr.fac_id
  JOIN tes t ON t.fac_id = fr.fac_id
  JOIN tar ta ON ta.fac_id = fr.fac_id
  JOIN mar ma ON ma.fac_id = fr.fac_id
)
SELECT fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(rdd::numeric, 2) AS resource_demand_differential
FROM m
WHERE rdd > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5
ORDER BY rdd DESC, fac_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref AS patient_id, asd.dx_dur_m AS diagnosis_duration_months,
  asd.prev_hosp AS previous_hospitalizations,
  (split_part(ab.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 15) AS meets_intensive_therapy_standard
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.ab_key = asd.asd_key
WHERE asd.prim_dx = 'Bipolar' AND asd.dx_dur_m >= 120 AND asd.prev_hosp > 3

WITH sym AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth, asr.phq9_scr, asr.gad7_scr
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = e.ab_ref
), eng AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth,
    CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END AS eng_score
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
), adh AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth,
    CASE WHEN tou.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS adh_flag
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tou ON tou.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
), s AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pat_eth, 'All Ethnicities') AS eth, (AVG(phq9_scr) + AVG(gad7_scr)) / 2 AS ssi
  FROM sym GROUP BY ROLLUP(pat_eth)
), g AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pat_eth, 'All Ethnicities') AS eth, AVG(eng_score) AS tes
  FROM eng GROUP BY ROLLUP(pat_eth)
), a AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pat_eth, 'All Ethnicities') AS eth, AVG(adh_flag) AS tar
  FROM adh GROUP BY ROLLUP(pat_eth)
)
SELECT s.eth AS patient_ethnicity,
  ROUND(s.ssi, 2) AS symptom_severity_index,
  ROUND((g.tes + a.tar * 3) / 2, 2) AS engagement_adherence_score
FROM s
LEFT JOIN g ON g.eth = s.eth
LEFT JOIN a ON a.eth = s.eth
ORDER BY s.eth

WITH tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
    AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), outc AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
    AVG(CASE lower(tou.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') WHEN 'significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'minimal' THEN 1 END) AS avg_fi,
    AVG(CASE WHEN tou.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tou ON tou.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
)
SELECT t.fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(t.tes, 2) AS avg_tes, ROUND(o.avg_fi * o.tar, 2) AS rti
FROM tes t JOIN outc o ON o.fac_id = t.fac_id
WHERE t.tes > 2.0 AND o.avg_fi * o.tar < 0.8
ORDER BY t.fac_id
LIMIT 100
